course.title: Basic Quantum Mechanics and Solid State Physics
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Gold has the same structure as copper. The velocity of sound in gold is 2100 ms-1 and that in copper is 3800 ms-1. If the Debye temperature of copper is 348 K, determine the Debye temperature of gold. The densities of gold and copper are respectively 1.93×104 kgm3 and 8960 kgm-3 and their atomic weights are 197.0 and 63.54 a.m.u. respectively.
